headline: PONG gets its score dial
lede: Slot a shipped a selectable max-score knob on the PONG cabinet: turn RANGE to 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9 and the first player to reach it wins for real. FREE keeps the classic play-to-quit table — the machine's own default.

notes.text: The target binds in the physics, not the UI: the winning point ends the match, no dead ball is served, no dice are burned, and the card shows FIRST TO N with an ascending win sting.

Honest history, written into the README: the 1972 cabinet's RANGE switch was the Easy/Difficult speed control — already the EASY/NORMAL/HARD tiers. The score dial is a feature stacked on the honest terminal, named as one.
pongcheck §range pins the exact-cap law: 40/40 driver wins at range 3, all ending at exactly 3–<3 with five points conceded total; three new mutants (silent cap, off-by-one, FREE-as-cap) die.
Real Chrome leg: dial keys, a thumb on the label, a cap win heard as 660→880 Hz, restart with the target standing. pongdrive 47/47; polish pass #3576 filed for the QA lane.

look.text: Pick a number, first to it wins honestly
